sources.snippet: ai-sage/GigaChat3-10B-A1.8B-bf16 architecture at a glance ai-sage/GigaChat3-10B-A1.8B-bf16 is a model (deepseek_v3 architecture). It uses 26 transformer layers, a hidden size of 1,536, and multi-head latent attention (MLA). The feed-forward layers use a mixture-of-experts design with 64 experts (4 active per token, 1 always-on).
